newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSABANK LATVIA PROFIT UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: HANSABANK LATVIA PROFIT UP IN APRIL.

text.p: Hansabank Latvia, the subsidiary of Estonia's leading bank Hansabank , had a net profit of 151,900 lats in April compared to 68,900 lats in March, Hansabank said on Wednesday.
Hansabank Latvia's total assets increased by 21 percent in April, amounting to 67 million lats at the end of the month, it added in a statement.
The bank's profit for the current year is 452,100 lats as of the end of April.
The bank also said that its loan portfolio increased by 32 percent or 4.8 million lats in April to 19.9 million lats.
Deposits increased by 25 percent or 10.7 million lats to 54.3 million lats. Time deposits rose by 101 percent or 6.8 million lats, while demand deposits rose by 11 percent or 3.9 million lats.
Equity rose by 151,900 lats, the April profit, to 3.7 million lats.
